Scenario: Calendar view opens from workspace nav
Preconditions: Tester can sign in with an active staff account.
Steps: 1. Sign in. 2. Click Calendar in the workspace nav or open /app?view=calendar.
Expected Result: The Calendar page loads with calendar controls and the Calendar navigation item selected.

Preconditions: Calendar view is accessible.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=calendar.
Expected Result: Week mode is selected and a weekly grid is displayed.

Scenario: Day mode switches from week mode
Preconditions: Calendar view is open.
Steps: 1. Click Day.
Expected Result: The view changes to a daily appointment list for the anchor date.

Scenario: Week mode switches from day mode
Preconditions: Calendar view is open in Day mode.
Steps: 1. Click Week.
Expected Result: The view changes back to the weekly grid.

Scenario: Today button returns to current Manila date
Preconditions: Calendar anchor is not today.
Steps: 1. Click Previous or Next. 2. Click Today.
Expected Result: The calendar returns to today's Manila date.

Scenario: Previous and next navigate by active mode
Preconditions: Calendar view is open.
Steps: 1. In Week mode click Previous and Next. 2. In Day mode click Previous and Next.
Expected Result: Week mode moves by seven days; Day mode moves by one day.

Preconditions: At least two active piercers exist.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=calendar. 2. Select a piercer from Filter by piercer.
Expected Result: The calendar reloads and shows appointments for the selected piercer only.

Scenario: Piercer filter is locked for piercer role
Preconditions: Tester is signed in as a piercer.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=calendar. 2. Inspect Filter by piercer.
Expected Result: The filter is disabled and scoped to the signed-in piercer.

Preconditions: At least two stations exist.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=calendar. 2. Select a station from Filter by station.
Expected Result: The calendar reloads and shows appointments for the selected station only.

Preconditions: At least one visible appointment exists in the selected week.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=calendar in Week mode. 2. Inspect an appointment block.
Expected Result: The block shows start time, client name, piercer or Unassigned, station or No station, and service names.

Scenario: Clicking a day header opens day view
Preconditions: Calendar is in Week mode.
Steps: 1. Click a date header in the week grid.
Expected Result: The selected date becomes the anchor date and Day mode opens.

Preconditions: Two or more appointments overlap on the same day.
Steps: 1. Open the week containing overlapping appointments. 2. Inspect the overlapping time range.
Expected Result: Overlapping appointment blocks are laid out in separate lanes and remain selectable.

Preconditions: At least one visible appointment exists on the selected date.
Steps: 1. Open Day mode for that date. 2. Inspect an appointment row.
Expected Result: The row shows start and end time, client initials, client name, services, reference, piercer, station, status, and a chevron.

Preconditions: Selected date has no appointments after filters are applied.
Steps: 1. Open Day mode. 2. Select a clear date or restrictive filters.
Expected Result: The page shows No appointments this day with clear explanatory text.

Preconditions: At least one visible appointment exists.
Steps: 1. Click an appointment in Week or Day mode.
Expected Result: The appointment dialog opens with customer name, reference, status, services, time, piercer, station, linked sale, contact, and notes.

Preconditions: Appointment dialog is open.
Steps: 1. Click the close button or press Escape.
Expected Result: The dialog closes and the calendar remains on the same date and mode.

Preconditions: At least one active service, eligible piercer, and station configuration exists.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=calendar. 2. Click New appointment.
Expected Result: The New appointment dialog opens with service selection, client mode, piercer, station, date, Manila time, notes, and confirmation email controls.

Scenario: Create button disabled until service and eligible piercer selected
Preconditions: New appointment dialog is open.
Steps: 1. Open New appointment. 2. Leave services unselected. 3. Select services but no eligible piercer where possible.
Expected Result: Create appointment remains disabled until at least one service and an eligible piercer are selected.

Scenario: Existing client appointment can be created
Preconditions: Existing client exists; selected piercer is eligible and available; selected time is within business rules.
Steps: 1. Open New appointment. 2. Select service. 3. Keep Existing client selected. 4. Choose client, piercer, station, date, and time. 5. Click Create appointment.
Expected Result: The dialog closes and the new appointment appears in the calendar.

Scenario: New client appointment can be created
Preconditions: Selected piercer is eligible and available; selected time is within business rules; use unique email.
Steps: 1. Open New appointment. 2. Select service. 3. Switch to New client. 4. Enter first name, last name, email, and phone. 5. Choose piercer, station, date, and time. 6. Click Create appointment.
Expected Result: The dialog closes, the client is created, and the appointment appears in the calendar.

Scenario: Combined duration updates with selected services
Preconditions: At least two active services exist with durations.
Steps: 1. Open New appointment. 2. Select one service. 3. Select another service.
Expected Result: Combined duration text updates to the sum of selected service durations.

Preconditions: Choose a time that violates availability, overlap, closure, or business-hour rules.
Steps: 1. Open New appointment. 2. Enter invalid scheduling details. 3. Click Create appointment.
Expected Result: The dialog remains open and an error message explains that the appointment could not be created or why the schedule is invalid.

Preconditions: A visible appointment exists.
Steps: 1. Open an appointment. 2. Click Reschedule.
Expected Result: The dialog changes to Reschedule appointment and shows date, Manila time, piercer, and station controls.

Scenario: Management can change piercer when rescheduling
Preconditions: A visible appointment exists and another eligible piercer is available.
Steps: 1. Open appointment. 2. Click Reschedule. 3. Change piercer. 4. Save new schedule.
Expected Result: The schedule saves when valid and the calendar refreshes with the updated piercer.

Scenario: Piercer cannot change piercer when rescheduling
Preconditions: Tester is signed in as piercer and has a visible appointment.
Steps: 1. Open appointment. 2. Click Reschedule. 3. Inspect Piercer field.
Expected Result: The Piercer field is disabled for the piercer role.

Preconditions: A visible appointment exists and a valid alternate date/time is available.
Steps: 1. Open appointment. 2. Click Reschedule. 3. Enter valid date, time, piercer, and station. 4. Click Save new schedule.
Expected Result: The dialog closes and the appointment appears at the updated schedule.

Preconditions: A confirmed appointment exists and user has access to it.
Steps: 1. Open confirmed appointment. 2. Click Complete & create sale.
Expected Result: The appointment status changes to completed, a linked sale is created, and the calendar refreshes.

Scenario: Confirmed appointment can be marked no-show
Preconditions: A confirmed appointment exists and user has access to it.
Steps: 1. Open confirmed appointment. 2. Click No-show.
Expected Result: The appointment status changes to no_show and the calendar refreshes.

Preconditions: A confirmed appointment exists and user has access to it.
Steps: 1. Open confirmed appointment. 2. Click Cancel.
Expected Result: The appointment is cancelled and no longer appears in the visible calendar list.

Preconditions: Temporarily simulate API failure or network issue.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=calendar while appointments API is unavailable.
Expected Result: An alert message appears saying the calendar could not be loaded.

Scenario: Calendar remains usable on mobile width
Preconditions: Browser dev tools or mobile device is available.
Steps: 1. Open /app?view=calendar. 2. Resize viewport to mobile width. 3. Test controls, week scroll, day list, and dialogs.
Expected Result: Calendar controls remain reachable, horizontal week scrolling works, and dialogs fit without overlapping content.
